# Classifieds
[italic]Notices from readers, set as received. The Herald does not vouch for any of it. Notices run free, whatever floor you live on.[/italic]
## Housing - [bold]ROOM TO LET[/bold], fourth floor, inside unit with no window and no draught. Shared shower on the landing. Suits a hangar worker on rotating shifts. Ask at the coffee machine on four. - [bold]WANTED[/bold], any bunk above the sixth floor. Current bunk is on two, and the stairwell there smells of the basement. - Official allocations are posted by the colony at [netlink="Seegson housing assignments" link="colony.seegson.net/housing"].
## Work - [bold]FREIGHT HANDS WANTED[/bold] at the West Hangar. Night unloading, lift card supplied. Must know to stand clear of a moving cargo lift without being told twice. - [bold]WASTE CREW[/bold] needed to clear the disposal lines. Good pay, bad smell. Bring your own gloves. - [bold]HYDROPONICS HELP[/bold], two shifts a week tending trays. Paid partly in fresh greens.
## For Sale and Trade - [bold]VENT SCREENS[/bold], cut to size for room vents. Keeps the sand out of your bedding and your lungs. Ten credits a pair. - [bold]WORK HARNESS[/bold], lightly used, never fallen. Will trade for a good pair of boots.
## Lost and Found - [bold]LOST[/bold]: orange cat, answers to Sixpence, last seen heading into the vents on the third floor. Please do not open the grilles, just call her name. - [bold]FOUND[/bold]: a lift keycard on the stairs to the rooftop pad. Collect it at the press office by naming the floor it opens.
## Notices - To the tenant on eight who keeps dropping things down the atrium well: we have a list, and next week it goes to print.
To place a notice, find the Herald's correspondent or leave a comment under any story on the front page.
